title: Don’t use it in direct sunlight
text: Don’t use it in direct sunlight. I loved this for my table on my deck. The only reason I give this a 4 star, is because it faded fast. It cleans easily, looked really nice for my company and I didn’t have to worry about it blowing up.

product_metadata.title: Rally Home Goods Indoor Outdoor Patio Round Fitted Vinyl Tablecloth, Flannel Backing, Elastic Edge, Waterproof Wipeable Plastic Cover, Lucky 4-Leaf Clover Patterns for 5-Seat Table of 36-42’’ Diameter
features: ✅ Functional & Beautiful: With bright colors, flannel backing and four-leaf clover patterns, this vinyl tablecloth not only gives your table a new stylish look, but also protects your table from scratches, beverage spill, and kids arts & crafts mishaps, making your table last longer. Four-leaf clover is believed to bring luck to its owner. The elasticized edges keep the vinyl tablecloth tightly fitted and stay free from moving / falling off. It works in both dining room and outdoor settings

✅ Easy to Use and Clean: No stains of liquid/oil can be stubborn on this PVC vinyl tablecloth, because it is water and oil-proof and all liquids bead up on its surface. The vinyl (plastic) tablecloth is also much easier to wipe clean than fabric tablecloths. Creases, wrinkles or fold lines on vinyl can be easily removed by using a hair dryer: use the low-heat setting and use your hand to smooth out the creases as you apply the hot air to the surface.

✅ Serves Multi-Purposes: The ease of cleaning makes this vinyl table cover great for general all-purpose activities like dining, painting, board gaming, and working with modeling clay. It is super kids and family-friendly and keeps dirt and dust out of your outdoor patio tables

✅ Your Table Size Matters: The elasticized edge allows this vinyl tablecloth to fit round tables with a diameter between 36 - 42 inches (92 - 107 cm), which can seat up to 5 adults with 24-inch chair spacing. A bigger table will require a bigger tablecloth, and you can avoid the trouble of return & exchange by spending a few seconds measuring your table's size first - iPhone/Android phones have tape measure apps if you don't have a physical one handy
✅ 100% Customer Obsession: For questions on products, reach us by email through Amazon order history any time.
